proposed.choice: Generate locally into an owned versioned output root and read complete static snapshots offline.
proposed.rationale: Immutable per-version resources and one replaceable entry file separate preparation from commitment and preserve older readable versions.
alternatives: Overwrite a flat directory of live assets in place.
consequences: Initial target: Linux x86-64 and Node 24, with a bundled Rust engine built for x86_64-unknown-linux-musl and D2 0.9.0 with licenses. Qualify the exact binaries, kernel/filesystem behavior and runtime dependencies; other browser-generation targets reject.
Reader qualification covers exact Chromium and Firefox configurations recorded per release; reading requires no Node, Rust, D2, Python, source checkout, network or database.
Local filesystems with qualified atomic same-directory rename and durability behavior are required for replacement; network/synchronized filesystems are not initial qualified write targets.
revisit_when: A selected requirement, supported platform or actual qualification result defeats this realization.
